fullPassage: Learning games need to be what we call ‘fun enough.’ Many new learning-game developers try to design an entertaining game. Unfortunately, that often makes learning harder rather than easier. Remember, you are not creating the next great commercial game to entertain your learners; you are creating a learning game in which success will be measured by the achievement of learning outcomes. Resist the temptation to create a ton of rules, pile on different game elements, and incorporate multiple dynamics to keep player interest high. Yes, the game should be engaging with a mild level of fun, but learning should be the goal. Focus on engagement rather than entertainment. The goals of the game play should be interactivity and engagement. Research shows that what makes games instructional is the level of interactivity and engagement the learners have with the content. Given those parameters, making sure the learners are engaged and active is far more important than making sure they are entertained.

questions.passage: Learning games need to be what we call ‘fun enough.’ Many new learning-game developers try to design an entertaining game. Unfortunately, that often makes learning harder rather than easier. Remember, you are not creating the next great commercial game to entertain your learners; you are creating a learning game in which success will be measured by the achievement of learning outcomes. Resist the temptation to create __________, pile on different game elements, and incorporate multiple dynamics to keep player interest high. Yes, the game should be engaging with a mild level of fun, but learning should be the goal. Focus on engagement rather than entertainment. The goals of the game play should be interactivity and engagement. Research shows that what makes games instructional is the level of interactivity and engagement the learners have with the content. Given those parameters, making sure the learners are engaged and active is far more important than making sure they are entertained.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 수많은 규칙(a ton of rules)을 만들려는 유혹을 참으라 — 뒤의 game elements·dynamics와 병렬
det.analysis:
❌ ① a set of goals(일련의 목표): 문맥 부적절
❌ ② a piece of advice(한 가지 조언): 문맥 부적절
✅ ③ a ton of rules(수많은 규칙): 'create ___, pile on game elements' 규칙을 잔뜩 만들려는 유혹 ←정답
❌ ④ a sense of humor(유머 감각): 문맥 부적절
det.tip: a ton of ~ = 수많은 ~. 규칙·요소·역학을 잔뜩 넣으려는 유혹

det.korean: 학습자를 '참여시키고 능동적이게(engaged and active)' 하는 것이 즐겁게 하는 것보다 중요
det.analysis:
❌ ① quiet and still(조용하고 가만히): 문맥 부적절
❌ ② amused and relaxed(즐겁고 편안한): 오락에 가까워 글의 주장과 반대
❌ ③ bored and passive(지루하고 수동적인): 문맥 부적절
✅ ④ engaged and active(참여하고 능동적인): entertained와 대조되는 핵심 개념 ←정답
det.tip: engaged and active ↔ entertained. 참여·능동이 오락보다 중요
